gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-carrois-gothic-s: Carrois Gothic SC keeps its curves open and its lowercase nearly capital-tall. Fuzzy Bubbles above it draws a rounded, handwritten line that never changes pressure, while the sans below stays tidy and contemporary.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-cascadia-code: Spaced-out and wire-thin, Cascadia Code is plain sans with smooth bends, while Fuzzy Bubbles hand-draws the headings. Long paragraphs would move steadily, one spaced letter at a time.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-cascadia-mono: Fuzzy Bubbles writes rounded, drafting-pen letters whose small forms nearly match the capitals in height. Cascadia Mono stands compact and pin-straight in sans-serif, and that loose-against-tight split is the pair's whole appeal.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-chivo: Chivo packs its lowercase up toward the capitals, with daylight in every curve. Fuzzy Bubbles above it is all dowel-like stems and bent-dowel arcs, a handwritten warmth that the plain sans keeps grounded.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-chocolate-classi: Relaxed and personal, Fuzzy Bubbles draws every stroke at a single thickness, round and handwritten. Chocolate Classical Sans is plain sans with sizable lowercase and broad-nibbed curves that stay open, which is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-comme: Comme is a sans with smooth, unclogged curves and lowercase that fills most of the letter height. Comme is built for smooth reading, whereas Fuzzy Bubbles excels at a rounded, compass-pencil steadiness.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte is plain sans with wide-eyed lowercase e's and a prominent x-height. Cossette Texte gives the rounded, relaxed drafting-pen headings of Fuzzy Bubbles a sturdy, clean partner underneath.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-duru-sans: Modern and clean, Duru Sans lets wide openings show on small letters. And because its bodies dominate the line, Duru Sans can go a touch smaller than you'd expect beside neon-tube Fuzzy Bubbles.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-epunda-slab: Dignified Epunda Slab has tall, rounded lowercase and a gaping c. Under Fuzzy Bubbles, whose strokes all carry equal visual weight, this serif would carry paragraphs at a stately, unhurried pace.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One is a literary serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders and descenders. And beside the marker-like constant line of Fuzzy Bubbles, that dignified bookishness is the pair's main charm.
